analysis: Patient with ECOG 2, former smoker, presenting with recurrent severe neutropenia (grade 4) and leukopenia, anemia, and late-onset ascites. Immediate threats include sepsis risk from prolonged neutropenia and possible hepatic decompensation with ascites. Hemodynamic and respiratory status require urgent assessment.
evidences: Grade 4 neutropenia (day 15-21) with subsequent recurrent neutropenic episodes
Late-onset ascites (day 365) suggesting possible hepatic or malignant progression
Persistent anemia and thrombocytopenia indicating bone marrow suppression
